messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning a geo routing handoff tomorrow 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC. Target regions: NA-W -> NA-W2 and EU-S -> EU-S2. Plan is a gradual weighted swap over ~20m. Need owners for DNS weight flips, edge policy deploy, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Who can take what?
maria: I can own the DNS weight changes + verification. Will script the weight increments and post logs here.
devon: I’ll run the edge policy deploy (infra job). I want a hard gate: preflight success, then kick. ETA 10:00-10:30 window.
kevin: I’ll monitor runtime metrics (p50/p95 latency, 5xx, 429, error-rate) and watch the routing dashboard. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/geo-routing
ella: Quick smoke checklist I suggest: 1) basic request path through new edge (curl) 2) prefix KV cache health 3) token auth flows 4) sample-prod prompt latencies. I’ll post commands.
ella: ```bash
# basic curl smoke
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY' https://na.example.redwood/api/health | jq .status
# dig check for new CNAMEs
dig +short _edge.na-w2.example.redwood CNAME
```
maria: I’ll run the scripted weight steps: 0->10->30->60->100 over 20m, with 5m holds. Will paste outputs.
sam: @devon can you confirm deploy job id and rollback job ready? Also please set small TTL (30s) during the flip.
devon: deploy-bot: triggered edge-policy-deploy #4721 for na-w2/eu-s2 at 10:00 UTC. rollback job edge-policy-rollback #4722 staged. I’ll keep the job muted until signoff.
kevin: I’ll set alerts: p95 spike > 200ms, error-rate > 0.5% will be paging oncall. Also watch cache hit ratio.
sre-bot: Reminder: open incident channel if rollback triggered: #incidents — use template "routing-handback".
ella: Small preflight script I’ll run at 09:40 UTC and post results. If any of these fail, we abort: auth errors, >1% 5xx, DNS mismatch.
maria: TTL change: I’ll lower default to 30s at 09:55, and restore 1m after stable.
sam: Ok owners locked: maria (DNS weights/TTL), devon (deploy + rollback), kevin (metrics/alerts), ella (smoke steps).
devon: I’ll also keep the infra toggle to force-old-edge if we need immediate rollback (flip control is in infra-console).
kevin: Oncall for the window: @maria please confirm backup pager (alex).
maria: @alex confirmed. :thumbsup:
sam: Final asks: paste smoke outputs, tag logs with "geo-handback-1912345678", and if anything suspicious escalate immediately in this thread.
deploy-bot: job #4721 started at 10:00:12 UTC — step 1 policy push -> queued on na-w2 nodes.
kevin: Seeing initial p50 stable. No spike yet.
ella: Smoke step 1 results: auth OK, sample prompt ok, cache hit 82%. Posting snippets in logs.
maria: Weight -> 10% applied at 10:05 (na-w2). Dig shows new CNAMEs propagating.
devon: Noted. Holding on next weight until 10:10 for observation.
kevin: p95 rose 15ms, 5xx = 0.02% — within threshold.
ella: smoke step 2 passed. Will run expanded prompt set at 10:12.
maria: Weight -> 30% applied at 10:15.
kevin: small latency bump but stable. No errors.
devon: If we need to rollback, I'll trigger edge-policy-rollback #4722 and ask maria to restore weights. Ready but holding.
sam: Great. Keep this thread for final confirmation once at 100%. After stable for 10m we restore TTL to 60s and close out.
maria: 100% applied at 10:25, monitoring.
kevin: Stable for 10m, p95 and error-rate normal.
sam: Closing window — great job everyone. Will file short runbook note and handoff in eng-runbooks. :tada:
